You dont need flashy titles or acheivements, its about the story you make out of it and how nice you make it sound; I sent HBA admissions an email and this is what they said in reponse: ; For future applications, I would suggest focusing on clearly demonstrating: What you noticed or identified in your environment; What actions you took and why; What changed or improved as a result of your involvement; What you learned and how it shaped your perspective; Concrete examples of leadership, teamwork, initiative taken, achievements, resilience, integrity and your commitment levels to each activity

Yes—a supplementary evaluation. It involved a questionnaire with 4 questions, and then an interview that could be done either online or in person. I did it online, via video upload, which... was honestly very poorly done.
This was my online video interview. https://www.loom.com/share/890335fec0214b0389ed3b678570ccc7; I had a lot of experience from directing shows as a part of my drama club, and was involved a lot with NTS. For the questionnaire they asked for a detailed recount of a live performance I had recently seen, and I talked about the details of a live performance I had stage tickets for, which allowed me to closely see the operations and relate to professional performers.
Got a $3500 scholarship. Am an IB student taking HL english, business, biology and SL chemistry, french and math aa.; I applied as a part of York's Concurrent BEd program (program code: YQ), which evaluates your submission after you are first accepted into a partnering department at the university. Got this offer, and am still waiting on the ConEd program. This means tjat technically on OUAC, this offer has been listed as an "Alternate Offer" as it stands whether or not I get into the BEd program. However, when initially applying on OUAC, I only needed to put the YQ program with my subject of major interest.

Full IB. Your average does not matter, this is just what I used for my main program. Did Mathematics for Education if you're curious, that should be on the spreadsheet too. My hours honestly is pretty unimpressive and I didn't think I'd get in, looking back I think I only got in thanks to my personal statement which looking back genuinely feels like a rant more than anything. (I don't think it's good.) Feel free to DM me on Discord (probablyfelix) for any questions, I'm happy to answer any time. Even if the year's 2035. One last thing for if you're viewing this spreadsheet not as a Grade 12: if you know how to swim, get your First Aid and National Lifeguard certifications and become a swim instructor. Extremely easy way to get money, get a recc letter (that's where one of mine came from, anyways) and lets you farm tons of hours to put onto your SIF.
